# Sup de Luxe

> > Sup de Luxe is France's leading luxury management business school, offering MBA and Bachelor programs in luxury brand marketing, fashion, jewelry, hospitality, and art management.

Part of EDC Paris Business School, Sup de Luxe (Institut Supérieur de Marketing du Luxe) has been training luxury industry professionals for nearly 30 years. The school offers ECTS-accredited programs including the MBA Luxury Brand Marketing & International Management and Bachelor Luxe, with strong connections to major luxury houses like LVMH, Cartier, and Richemont.

## Key Topics

- Luxury brand management
- MBA Luxury Brand Marketing & International Management
- Bachelor Luxe programs
- LVMH and luxury conglomerates
- Cartier and high jewelry
- Fashion product management
- Luxury hospitality careers
- Digital transformation in luxury
- Art management and museums
- Luxury brand storytelling
- Strategic partnerships (Richemont, Alibaba, Farfetch)
- Sustainable luxury (HVE certification)
- Alumni entrepreneurship
- ECTS European credit system
